title: Agentic RAG Launchpad lead, schema version 2
description: The JSON body the console posts to a deployment's lead webhook when a visitor sends the chat's contact form. Version 1's fields are unchanged; version 2 adds schemaVersion, consent, trigger and attribution. Optional fields may be added within version 2, so don't reject unknown ones. See docs/leads.md.

receivedAt.description: When the console received the lead.

deployment.description: The deployment's name in the console, e.g. "Main site".

customer.description: The name visitors see (the customer's "Name visitors see", else its name).

test.description: Present only when the form was sent from a staging domain or localhost: a test, not a real visitor. The subject starts "[Test, from a staging page]".

conversationId.description: The chat conversation's random id; the same id is on the chat's analytics events.

fields.description: What the visitor typed, for the fields the form shows. At least one of email and phone.

pageUrl.description: The page the form was sent from, without its query string or fragment.

language.description: The language the widget reported (version 1). consent.language is the one it was served in.

transcript.description: The conversation, only when the visitor ticked "Include this conversation".

consent.description: The consent the visitor gave by ticking the form's box. Required: there is no lead without it.

text.description: The exact wording the visitor ticked, in their language.

language.description: The language it was shown in, e.g. "de".

privacyUrl.description: The privacy notice linked under the box, when one is set.

placement.description: header: "Talk to a person" in the chat header. no-answer: a reply with no answer. after-answer: "Still need help?" under an answer. cta: a call-to-action button.

ctaLabel.description: The button's label, in the visitor's language, when placement is cta.

attribution.description: Where the visit came from, captured on the first page of the visit (in the browser tab's sessionStorage, no cookies). Pages are without their query string; only these campaign keys are kept, and a value that looks like an email address is dropped. Empty when the visitor's browser blocks storage and nothing was found on the page.

subject.description: Added by delivery: "New lead from the <customer> website chat".

text.description: Added by delivery: a readable summary, which Slack and Teams show.
